[[Vash]] sends your [[party]] to [[Urgoz's Warren]].

==Locations==
*[[Kaineng City]]
**{{NPC location|Kaineng Center}} (only appears during Factions Elite [[Weekly bonuses|weekly bonus]])
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|House zu Heltzer}} (he can only be accessed by members of the [[alliance]] that [[Kurzick-Luxon border|controls]] House zu Heltzer)

==Dialogue==
:''"Years ago, Urgoz was the protector of Echovald Forest. At that time, we [[Kurzick]]s worked in tandem with [[Urgoz]] and his [[Warden]]s, maintaining order and balance within the forest, and keeping it free from any evil taint. After the [[Jade Wind]] passed over Echovald, the Wardens became increasingly violent, attacking our people on sight, and Urgoz himself is now more of a [[demon]] lord than forest guardian. Perhaps this sounds extreme, but I really don't think he will be satisfied until he has slain every last one of us. We need to destroy him before there are any more Kurzick casualties. By chance, I have found a secret way into his very lair. If you are up to the challenge and wish to show your loyalty to my people, I will send you in there."''
:;{{ask|gold}} Can you take me to Urgoz's Warren?
::''"Just let me know when you are ready."
::;{{yes|ingame}} I am ready.
:::''"Clicking "Accept" will take you into Urgoz's Warren. Once inside, you will be able to reform your party and adjust your [[skill]]s before proceeding. Are you sure you would like to enter Urgoz's Warren now?"
:::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am sure.''' (sent to [[Urgoz's Warren (outpost)]])
:::;{{no|ingame}} Perhaps not.
::;{{no|ingame}} I am not ready.
:;{{no}} I'll be on my way.

==Notes==
*Both Vash and [[Eurayle]] enter Kaineng Center from [[Bukdek Byway]] when a player loads into a new instance.
